title: Iifayile Ezikhutshelweyo Ziya Phi? Isikhokelo se-Android ne-iPhone
description: Awuyifumani ifayile oyikhuphelileyo? Jonga apho iifayile ziya khona kwi-Android, iPhone, iPad nakwikhompyutha, nendlela yokudlulisela ividiyo kwi-Gallery.
photo2Caption: Kwi-laptop, iifayile ziya kwifolda ethi Downloads.
body:
Sele ucofe iqhosha lokukhuphela, kodwa ividiyo awuyifumani kwi-gallery? Musa ukukhathazeka, le yingxaki eqhelekileyo kakhulu. Ngokuqhelekileyo ifayile sele igciniwe, kodwa ikwifolda eyahlukileyo kunaleyo ubucinga ngayo. Esi sikhokelo sichaza apho iifayile ezikhutshelweyo zigcinwa khona kwi-Android, iPhone, iPad, nakwikhompyutha, kunye nendlela yokuzidlulisela ukuze kube lula ukuzivula.

Inkcazelo engezantsi isebenza kwiifayile ozikhuphele nge-browser, kuquka iividiyo, isandi, neefoto ezivela kwi-I Need Save. Iifayile zithunyelwa ngqo zisuka kwiqonga lokuqala ziye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye azigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save, ngoko ikopi ikwifowuni okanye kwi-laptop yakho kuphela.

Indawo yeefayile ezikhutshelweyo kwi-Android

Kwi-Android, iifayile ezikhutshelwe nge-browser zingena kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Indlela yokuyivula:

  1. Vula i-app yokulawula iifayile kwifowuni yakho. Igama layo lahlukile ngokohlobo lwefowuni, umzekelo My Files, Files, okanye File Manager.
  2. Khetha Okukhutshelweyo okanye Downloads.
  3. Lungelelanisa ngomhla wamva nje ukuze iifayile osandula ukuzikhuphela zibe phezulu.
  4. Cofa ifayile ukuze idlale, okanye uyibambe ixeshana ukuze uyidlulisele, uyithiye ngokutsha, okanye wabelane ngayo.

Enye indlela ekhawulezayo: vula imenyu ye-browser, uze ukhethe icandelo lokukhuphela (Downloads). Apho kukho uluhlu lweefayile osandula ukuzigcina, kwaye ungazivula ngqo apho.

Kutheni ividiyo ingekaveli kwi-Gallery?

I-app ye-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha ifuna ixesha elincinci ukuskena iifayile ezintsha. Ukuba ividiyo ayikabonakali, linda kancinci, uze uvale uphinde uvule i-app ye-Gallery. Kwezinye iifowuni, iividiyo ezivela kwifolda ethi Download ziboniswa kwi-albhamu eyahlukileyo ebizwa ngokuba yi-Download okanye Downloads, ngoko jonga nakuluhlu lwee-albhamu.

Indawo yeefayile ezikhutshelweyo kwi-iPhone nakwi-iPad

Kwi-iPhone nakwi-iPad, iifayile ezikhutshelwe nge-Safari azingeni ngqo kwi-app ethi Photos. Zigcinwa kwi-app ethi Files (Iifayile) kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo).

Ukuze ividiyo ibukelwe kwi-app ethi Photos, landela la manyathelo:

  1. Vula i-app ethi Files.
  2. Ngena kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo).
  3. Cofa ividiyo ofuna ukuyidlulisela de ivuleke.
  4. Cofa iqhosha elithi Share (Yabelana).
  5. Khetha Save Video (Gcina Ividiyo).

Emva koko ividiyo iya kuvela kwi-app ethi Photos kunye nezinye iividiyo. Kwiifoto, amanyathelo ayafana: vula ifoto kwi-Files, cofa Share, uze ukhethe ukhetho lokugcina umfanekiso.

Emva kokuba ividiyo igcinwe kwi-Photos, ungayicima ikopi ekwifolda ethi Downloads ukuze indawo yokugcina ye-iPhone yakho ihlale inendawo.

Indawo yeefayile ezikhutshelweyo kwi-laptop nakwikhompyutha

Kwi-Windows nakwi-Mac, iifayile ezikhutshelwe nge-browser ngokuqhelekileyo zingena kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo).

  • I-Windows: vula i-File Explorer, uze ucofe Downloads kwiphaneli esekhohlo.
  • I-Mac: vula i-Finder, uze ukhethe Downloads kwi-sidebar.
  • Kwi-browser: vula uluhlu lokukhuphela lwe-browser. Kwi-Chrome ye-Windows, umzekelo, ungacofa Ctrl+J.

Ukuba wakhe watshintsha useto lwe-browser ukuze iifayile zigcinwe kwenye ifolda, jonga loo folda kuseto lokukhuphela lwe-browser yakho.

Iifayile zesandi neefoto zigcinwa phi?

Indawo iyafana neyeevidiyo. Isandi, nokuba sesomgangatho wokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe kwividiyo, siya kungena kwifolda ethi Downloads. Kunjalo nakwiifoto nemifanekiso emincinci. Kwi-Android, iifayile ze-MP3 ngokuqhelekileyo zingadlalwa kwi-app yokulawula iifayile okanye kwi-app yomculo. Kwi-iPhone, iifayile zesandi zingadlalwa ngqo kwi-app ethi Files.

Ukuba ufuna ukwazi indlela yokuthatha isandi kwividiyo, funda isikhokelo esithi indlela yokuguqula iividiyo zemidiya yoluntu zibe yi-MP3.

Akukho fayile konke konke? Jonga oku

  • Ukukhuphela akukagqitywa. Ezinye iividiyo zifuna ukusetyenzwa kuqala, kwaye iqhosha liya kubonisa Iyalungiselela…. Linda de ukukhuphela kuqale ngokuzenzekelayo kwaye ungalivali iphepha ngokukhawuleza.
  • Indawo yokugcina igcwele. Ukuba indawo yokugcina iphantse yaphela, ukukhuphela kunokungaphumeleli. Khulula indawo encinci uze uzame kwakhona.
  • Umxholo awunakukhutshelwa. Umxholo wabucala, umxholo ofuna ukungena, okanye umxholo othintelwe ngokommandla ngokwenene awunakugcinwa.

Ukuba sele uyifumene ifayile kodwa ayidlali, jonga izisombululo kwinqaku elithi ividiyo ekhutshelweyo ayidlali.

Enye into: gcina umxholo kuphela ukuze uwusebenzisele wena kwaye uhloniphe ilungelo lokushicilela labadali. Ukuba ufuna ukuwupapasha kwakhona, qala ucele imvume uze ukhankanye umdali.

Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo

Ngaba indawo yokugcina iifayile ezikhutshelweyo inokutshintshwa?

Kwikhompyutha, uninzi lwee-browser lukuvumela ukuba ukhethe ifolda yokukhuphela kwimenyu yoseto. Kwifowuni, olu khetho luxhomekeke kwi-browser nakwinkqubo oyisebenzisayo.

Kutheni kwi-iPhone ividiyo ingangeni ngqo kwi-Photos?

I-Safari igcina iifayile ezikhutshelweyo kwi-app ethi Files. Kufuneka uvule ividiyo kwi-Files, ucofe Share, uze ukhethe Save Video.

Ngaba iifayile zam zigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save?

Hayi. Iifayile zithunyelwa ngqo zisuka kwiqonga lokuqala ziye kwisixhobo sakho, ngoko gcina kakuhle iifayile ezibalulekileyo.
